Figure 1. Overview of the MMBench-Live framework. MMBench-Live is constructed by converting the original MMBench into structured descriptions, acquiring new data in a task-aware manner, and generating executable and verified QA pairs for evaluation.

Figure 2. Rank change heatmap between MMBench and MMBench-Live. Each cell shows the rank difference ∆Rank = RankLive− RankMMBench for a given model–task pair. All tasks are denoted using abbreviated names and full task names are provided in the appendix C.
